narration: Rose's lamp had one charge left. A traveler was waiting at the dark bridge. She carried the light past her own doorway and set it on the bridge rail. The traveler started across. A neighbor brought a second lamp. Another placed a third beside the shop. Rose locked her door and turned toward home. All three lamps lit the path.
